results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Manager - Vehicle Operations
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate an autonomous delivery fleet in Abu Dhabi. This role owns the frontline team that keeps the fleet running — several hundred people, growing fast. The work spans remote monitoring of vehicles in service and on-road support in the field, run as one cross-trained team on a single roster. You own the machine that grows and runs it: the sourcing pipeline and manpower suppliers, the training and certification line, the roster, the quality bar, and the supervisors who run shifts once you can no longer be in every room. The operation is live seven days a week and the safety and quality floor does not move. What You'll Own The ramp — sourcing pipeline, manpower suppliers, hiring bar, onboarding throughput and attrition, plus the training and certification line that pushes that volume through without diluting the standard. Operator productivity, attendance and working-hour utilisation — and what has to change for those numbers to move. The management layer — the supervisors you recruit and promote, and the layered QA that tells you how a shift went when you weren't on it. Workforce operations at scale — visas, accommodation, transport, rostering compliance, and the allocation of field resources across competing demands. What You'll Need A frontline of several hundred, run full cycle — recruitment, training, rostering, performance, attrition. Not a contract population you coordinated with, but people you were accountable for and managed through supervisors. A ramp you personally delivered — took a team to several times its size, or mobilised a new site, centre or contract from nothing, with the numbers and the timeline to show it. Seated, real-time operations — control rooms, contact and service centres, command and dispatch centres, or autonomous-vehicle operations: people at consoles working live tasks against a response-time and quality standard. Dispersed field labour is a different job. A training and QA standard you built yourself — designed the assessment, set the pass bar, and made it hold across shifts. Running someone else's system is a different job. Strong English as a working language — you hire, train, appraise and resolve conflict directly with an Indian, Pakistani, Filipino and Ugandan frontline. A valid driving licence. Based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Strongly Preferred AV safety operator teams UAE blue-collar workforce operations — MOHRE, visas, accommodation, manpower suppliers 24/7 multi-shift operations Hindi, Urdu or Arabic What We Offer A UAE-benchmarked package, AI tools, visa sponsorship, and a non-rotating day shift. The Reality of the Job You would build the largest frontline team in Middle East autonomous delivery — several hundred people and growing fast, with the ramp, the standard and operator productivity all sitting with this one person. To be straight about the rest: the hiring and training pressure is relentless, and rostering and efficiency tooling is still incomplete — parts of the job run manually before they run on a system.

results.title: Operations Manager - Vehicle Distribution | Al-Futtaim Automotive | Logistics | Riyadh
results.description: Job Requisition ID: 180125 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day Overview Of The Role: The role requires ensuring compliance with customs and port authorities as well as adhering to KSA regulatory requirements. Success in this role involves on-time supply and delivery at minimal cost, maintaining budgeted net contribution through strategic cost management, and fostering strong relationships with customers and regulatory bodies. Update KPI dashboards and operational reports for management review through SAP systems. Develop, implement, and maintain SOPs for all logistics and supply chain activities within the division. Ensure SOPs are in place for all supply chain activities to standardize procedures. Monitor financial targets through monthly P&L review. Achieve Net Profit budget through strict cost control and monitoring financial dimensions. Maintain strong relationships with customers by providing proactive communication, advice, and operational feedback. Engage with customers regularly via email, calls, online Teams calls, and face-to-face contacts. Ensure timely delivery of vehicles and customer requirements across all showrooms, dealer, and distributor locations in KSA. Formulate and finalize SLAs with customers and negotiate with suppliers aligned with business objectives. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for customer and team interactions. What Qualifies You For The Role: Degree in any discipline from a recognized institution. At least 7 years of relevant experience in operations management or a related field. Proficiency in SAP and computer applications with a strong understanding of logistics processes. Excellent organizational, decision-making, and interpersonal skills. About Al-Futtaim Automotive A major division of the UAE-based Al-Futtaim Group of companies, Al-Futtaim Automotive is an industry leader with presence in 10 countries across the Middle East, Asia and Africa. Our core business activities at Al-Futtaim Automotive include distribution, manufacturing, leasing and aftersales, and we are firmly established as the regional representative of some of the world’s most iconic automotive brands: Toyota, Lexus, Honda, Jeep, Chrysler, Dodge, Volvo and RAM. We are driven by a customer-centric approach, constantly pushing the boundaries on innovation, quality standards, and value-added service across our vast universe of customers - right from motoring enthusiasts to fleet operators to contractors. Our mission is to become the leader in custom-made mobility solutions by delivering nothing less than world-class omni-channel experiences. We channel our local expertise and global trust to deliver one of the most comprehensive portfolios of mobility products and solutions, from passenger cars to SUVs, electric vehicles to high-performance motorbikes, commercial vehicles to industrial & construction equipment. What keeps the company moving forward is a 9000-member strong team, with inspiring possibilities for growth, throughout the career path. This is Al-Futtaim Automotive and we empower talent to move forward.

results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).
